headlines: Stop asking "who's picking up the kids?" in the family chat.
Because nobody checks the shared Google Calendar.
Daily family schedule, delivered to Telegram. Automatically.
One message every morning. Everyone knows the plan.
Built by a dad of 5 who was tired of the scheduling chaos.
The family calendar that reads itself out loud.
Telegram bot. Family schedule. Zero chaos.

voiceSummaries.title: Voice Summaries
voiceSummaries.description: Listen to your daily schedule as a 30-45 second audio clip. Perfect while getting ready or driving.

voiceCommands.title: Voice Commands
voiceCommands.description: Create, edit, or delete events by sending voice messages. No typing needed.

aiSummaries.title: AI-Powered Summaries
aiSummaries.description: Not just event lists - natural, personalized briefings that tell you what matters today.

multiCalendar.title: Multi-Calendar Sync
multiCalendar.description: Connect yours, your spouse's, kids' calendars - all in one summary with automatic attribution.

conflictDetection.title: Conflict Detection
conflictDetection.description: Warns you when events overlap or when someone is double-booked.

weather.title: Weather Integration
weather.description: Location-based forecast woven into your morning summary. Dress the kids accordingly.

reminders.title: Smart Reminders
reminders.description: Customizable alerts. For kids' events, get reminded for both start AND pickup times.

hebrewCalendar.title: Hebrew Calendar
hebrewCalendar.description: Hebrew dates with Gematria, Shabbat times, holidays, Rosh Chodesh - all built in.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-Language
multiLanguage.description: Hebrew, English, Russian, Spanish, French, German. Summaries in your preferred language.

step1.title: Start the bot
step1.description: Open Telegram, search for @family_calendar_telegram_bot, and hit Start.

step2.title: Connect your calendar
step2.description: One-click Google Calendar authorization. Your data stays yours.

step3.title: Wake up informed
step3.description: Every morning, your family gets the day's schedule. Read it or listen to it. Automatically.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need more.
pricing.note: 14-day free trial with full Pro access. No credit card required.

personalNote.text: Built by a dad of 5 who was tired of the "wait, who's picking up who today?" chaos. I built this for my own family first. Now I'm sharing it with yours.
personalNote.feedback: Questions or feedback? {link} - I read everything.
